duzeltme.govde:
In the Calvin cycle, rubisco combines CO₂ with RuBP to form 3-phosphoglycerate (3-PGA). ATP and NADPH are then used to reduce 3-PGA to G3P, and more ATP is used to regenerate RuBP from G3P. Algae were illuminated and then the light was switched off.
Time after light off (s)0103060
3-PGA (relative)1.01.62.12.2
RuBP (relative)1.00.60.20.1
Which explanation best accounts for the data?
duzeltme.secenekler[2].text: With no ATP or NADPH, 3-PGA cannot be reduced and RuBP cannot be regenerated, while rubisco keeps using up the remaining RuBP.
